name: LittleLab : Solar Experiment
summary:
**Welcome to the LittleLab!** In this experiment, you can find out how solar cells generate electricity from light and why they are usually orientated at an angle to the south on roofs. But first you have to set up the experiment in the lab. Dr Blubber will help you! Let's get started!
